import json, numpy as np
from gcartpole.config import load_config, dump_json
from gcartpole.evidence import runtime_metadata
from gcartpole.lqr_design import high_precision_lyapunov_factor
from gcartpole.modal import StateScales, dimensionless_absolute_transform
from scripts.make_lqr_checkpoint import finite_difference_dynamics
from scripts.search_swingup_capture import lqr_gain
cfg=load_config("configs/swingup12_uniform.yaml")
gain=lqr_gain(cfg,progress=1.,fd_eps=1e-7,control_cost=1000.,decimal_digits=80)
a,b=finite_difference_dynamics(cfg,1.,1e-7)
t=dimensionless_absolute_transform(12,StateScales(1.25,.15,.5,.75))
p,root,diag=high_precision_lyapunov_factor(a,b,gain,t,decimal_digits=80)
dump_json(dict(not_solution=True,gain=gain.tolist(),capture_value_factor=root.tolist(),diagnostics=diag,runtime=runtime_metadata(), maximum_matrix_entry=float(np.max(abs(p))), gain_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(gain))),"runs/frontier_campaign_20261001/n12_precision80_gain_value_design/result.json")
print(json.dumps(dict(diagnostics=diag,gain_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(gain)),max_P=float(np.max(abs(p))))))
